 #!/usr/bin/env python3

 """

-AWOS Batch Evaluation — Non-interactive version.

-Runs all 4 levels, saves report to .awos/eval_report.txt

+eval_awos_batch.py — Primary evaluation harness for AWOS-based Python agents.

+

+This module serves as the definitive test suite for assessing agent capabilities

+within the planner/worker/verifier architectural framework. It evaluates agents

+across four difficulty levels (L1-L4) by:

+

+  • Running tasks through the Orchestrator (planner → worker → verifier pipeline)

+  • Evaluating agent responses for correctness and completeness

+  • Checking Python syntax of agent-generated code via AST parsing

+  • Running pytest on relevant test suites to validate agent-generated code

+  • Tracking git diffs to measure code changes made by the agent

+  • Reporting structured results (syntax, tests, cost, time, diff) per task

+  • Computing a composite score (0-100) based on success, syntax, tests, and diff

+

+The harness integrates with BudgetLedger for cost tracking, Orchestrator for

+task execution, and git for change management. Results are saved to

+.awos/eval_report.txt for review and regression tracking.

 """
